material_findings.title: exact_live_is_being_used_as_an_integration_test

material_findings.disposition: after the final zero-call convergence bundle allow one R11 only; a new L1 defect produces an honest blocked decision rather than automatic R12

material_findings.title: implementation_and_governance_surface_has_exceeded_auditable_scale
material_findings.evidence: 12904-line executor, eight Specialist versions, six Lead versions, 69 T05 release JSON files, 52 T05 contract tests and 443 worklogs
material_findings.disposition: do not refactor the whole runtime inside T05; extract only the two current canonical policy owners now and schedule broader version-family consolidation after S4

material_findings.title: program_state_sources_are_not_reconciled
material_findings.evidence: top-level backlog says current RC-P36-067/068 while nested S4 status still says RC-P36-066; current_truth still says S3 in progress; the latest root-cause ledger reports 47 blockers including three S4 issues already exercised successfully
material_findings.disposition: reconcile the active backlog now and run a dedicated issue-by-issue historical blocker review before S5

material_findings.title: machine_readable_source_of_truth_allowed_duplicate_JSON_keys
material_findings.evidence: strict duplicate-key scan found one duplicated S4_T05_RC_P36_059_status in the program backlog and one duplicated first_provider_owned_numeric_drift_surface in the RC-P36-067/068 decision
material_findings.disposition: correct duplicates now and add duplicate-key validation to the existing release JSON validation path without creating a new gate family

material_findings.title: repository_release_slice_is_not_closeout_ready
material_findings.evidence: 793 staged files span multiple historical slices on a branch five commits ahead of origin
material_findings.disposition: do not call the current index a release candidate; before S5 create reviewed commit manifests and coherent rollback slices
